title: Foliated Quantum Error Correction for Qudits
summary: We present a framework for foliating any Pauli-based quantum error-correcting code over prime-dimensional qudits. For any such code, we obtain a qudit graph state that can be measured to perform fault-tolerant measurement-based quantum computing. Such a paradigm is of interest in platforms such as photonics, where measurement-based protocols are natural and high-dimensional states are readily available.
